about.title: About the Magnificent Monsters set
paragraphs: Magnificent Monsters is a Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG special set released on 4 September 2026, in the SEVENS & GO RUSH!! era. It has 126 cards, and with the 84 other rarities there are 210 to collect in all.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 126 cards, each in its main rarity) or the Master set (all 210, adding the 84 other rarities).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details and images come from YGOPRODeck, and prices from TCGplayer.
